# Theme tokens

Every colour, font, size, spacing value, radius, elevation level and motion duration used by a
UI component is read from `src/client/UI/Theme.luau`. This page lists them with the contrast
figures the tests check. Contrast is WCAG 2.x, computed by `Theme.contrast`.

## Palette

Text needs 4.5:1 or better on the surface it sits on (WCAG AA). Values under 4.5 are allowed
only for fills, borders and focus rings; `accent` is one of these and is never used for text.

## Elevation

Elevation is a fill step, not a shadow. Each level is lighter than the one below it.

| Level | Palette token |
|---|---|
| flat | surface |
| raised | raised |
| overlay | pressed |
